## Claim or passage
Quote the exact passage or section, if relevant.

## Evidence / source
Include a source, example, counterexample or practical experience. Clearly distinguish evidence from inference.

## Interpretation or proposal
What should change, or what would falsify the current hypothesis?

## Privacy and fairness
Please avoid private personal data, unverified accusations, or requests for a universal ranking of people.
